before_metrics.comment: exp-20260528-007 tested only whether ADDING the expectation increment improved ranking (observed_only_no_promotable_edge). The composite alpha_score itself had never been validated for monotonic predictive power.

change_summary: Runs the never-completed Ranking Score Replacement Test (alpha-direction memo section 9) for the composite cross-sectional alpha_score. Regenerates the canonical 3-window backtests (late_strong/mid_weak/old_thin, EV 5.1628/2.1402/0.5911, aggregate 7.8941, 61 trades), runs quant/entry_day_ranking_attribution.py per window to rebuild the PIT alpha_score rank of each filled entry, then aggregates rank-bucket and component-bucket attribution. PIT coverage is 1.0. Finding: filled core trades are degenerate on composite rank (56 top_decile / 5 top_quartile / 0 below), so monotonicity cannot be tested; 3 of 6 components (trend, expectation_revision, post_earnings_drift) are perfectly constant across fills (zero discriminating info); of the 3 dispersed components, relative_strength (-0.79 avg_r margin) and breadth_alignment (-0.66) invert with adequate sample, theme is flat.
decision_rule: Filled core trades are a selected sample. If rank buckets cannot populate a below-top_quartile comparison group AND no dispersed component shows a clean monotonic avg_r edge (>= 0.10 margin, both buckets >= 8 trades), the composite ranking surface cannot be validated on filled trades.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: The composite cross-sectional alpha_score rank, rebuilt PIT before each filled entry, has monotonic predictive power over realized outcomes across the canonical 3 windows.
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260528-007 tested only the expectation increment to ranking (observed_only_no_promotable_edge). The composite score itself was untested.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Entry-day PIT composite alpha_score rank bucket.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Top rank bucket out-returns a populated bottom rank bucket (monotonic, not jackpot), PIT coverage >= 0.95.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: regenerate 3 canonical backtests, run entry_day_ranking_attribution.py per window, run the aggregation script. 6 unit tests cover the judge branches.

hypothesis: The continuous cross-sectional composite alpha_score (trend 0.30 / relative_strength 0.25 / expectation_revision 0.20 / post_earnings_drift 0.10 / theme_participation 0.10 / breadth_alignment 0.05) rebuilt point-in-time as of the day before each filled core entry has monotonic predictive power over realized trade outcomes across the canonical 3 windows.
next_evidence_needed: Persist the daily cross_sectional_ranking_surface alpha_score for the ENTIRE candidate universe each day (filled + unfilled) with forward 5/10/20-day outcomes, then bucket all ranked candidates by decile and compare top-vs-bottom forward returns. Only that design has a bottom comparison group; filled-trade attribution is structurally blind to names the core never bought. Do not reintroduce expectation_revision / post_earnings_drift as ranking weights (zero dispersion among core fills) without that full-universe test.
